name: atk galette dough
instructions:
America's Test Kitchen's savory whole-wheat galette dough — the white-vinegar dough. THE galette crust ([[butter-pie-crust]] is the pie crust; this is the galette one).

=== INGREDIENTS ===

- 1 1/4 cups all-purpose flour
- 1/2 cup wheat flour
- 1 tbsp sugar
- 3/4 tsp table salt
- 10 tbsp butter (awkward: a bit more than a stick)
- 1 tsp white vinegar
notes:
=== SOURCE ===

America's Test Kitchen — their savory whole-wheat galette dough. Long referenced in this cookbook as 'the ATK whole wheat galette crust with white vinegar is perfect' — finally transcribed.

=== THE 10 TBSP AWKWARDNESS ===

10 tablespoons of butter is a bit more than a stick (a stick is 8 tbsp) — cut the extra 2 tbsp off a second stick.

=== VS BUTTER PIE CRUST ===

Compared to [[butter-pie-crust]]: more fat per flour, all-butter (no shortening), the whole wheat is structural rather than a variant, and the white vinegar (tenderness — it limits gluten development). This is the galette dough; the pie crust is for pies.

=== USERS ===

- [[sweet-potato-pies-and-galettes]]: both variants want this crust.
- [[mushroom-leek-galette]]: the other galette.
